description: Use for 'what should I look at today?' or 'who is worth a call?'. Returns the accounts in today's note: what we found (dated, with links), what it usually means for what you sell, who to reach and why, and roughly how much time there is. If no note went out yet today, returns what the next one would hold. Quiet days return nothing; that is normal. Saved records only, no new research.
name: get_daily_brief
title: Today's note
